JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Replace Stuff
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Replace Stuff: replace a building's material in place, blueprints over rock and fog, auto-bridges.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Allow Tool
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Allow Tool: more orders to allow, forbid, select similar, finish off and haul urgently.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: QualityBuilder
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: QualityBuilder: only your best builders build quality items, and buildings below a minimum quality are rebuilt.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Robots fail its "only the best builder" rule, and while they count they raise the bar for colonists.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: With Misc. Robots: QualityBuilder × Misc. Robots lets robots build only what they can reach.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.source: Rimling/ModKnowledge; ModSettingsOverrides feature D retired 02.10.2026; QualityBuilderRobots README

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Static Quality
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Static Quality: crafting and construction quality follows skill instead of a wide random roll.
